---
title: "MOB candidate evidence"
---

```{r setup}
source("_common.R")
mob <- targets::tar_read(mob_evidence, store = store)
```

The 2026-09-07 MOB run (`AI_create_ttl/runs/2026-09-07-mob-units-gpt`)
withheld candidates whose measurement semantics could not be determined from
the unit expression alone. This page retrieves corpus usage for every
candidate. Candidates are bridged to EML units through the `RCode_JP`
pseudo-qname and through the spelling-insensitive match key.

```{r counts}
status_counts <- mob$summary |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    candidates = dplyr::n(),
    with_corpus_usage = sum(datasets > 0),
    .by = status
  )
knitr::kable(status_counts)
```

## All candidates

```{r summary}
interactive_table(
  mob$summary |>
    dplyr::select(
      record_id, unit_expression, status, quantity_kind, bridge, eml_unit_names,
      uses, datasets, scopes, top_terms
    ),
  "mob_evidence",
  columns = list(eml_unit_names = wide(240), top_terms = wide(320))
)
```

## Example definitions for withheld candidates

Up to five distinct attribute definitions per withheld candidate.

```{r examples}
interactive_table(
  mob$examples, "mob_examples",
  columns = list(definition = wide(420))
)
```

## Draft answers to review questions

These are **draft interpretations** from the first-pass corpus review, for
the team to confirm. Verify them against the examples above.

| Question | Corpus evidence | Draft answer |
|---|---|---|
| `MO` (month) convention | GEP/ER "modeled over one month"; monthly N mineralization | A calendar or incubation month, not a fixed duration. Keep blocked, or model as per-month totals without an SI conversion. |
| `NUM` in `GM-PER-NUM`, `MilliM-PER-NUM` | Mass per leaf, petiole, or stipule; shoot length per individual | NUM counts organisms or organs. Candidate concept: mass or length per individual or organ. |
| `NUM-PER-L-MIN` | Decays per minute per liter (Th-234, ³H-leucine) | Radioactivity concentration (dpm/L), commensurate with Bq/L × 60. |
| `NUM-PER-GM-MIN` | Excess ²¹⁰Pb in soil | Specific activity (dpm/g). |
| `NUM-PER-KiloM` | Species abundance per survey km; drainage density | Polysemous: linear abundance vs. drainage density. |
| PPM per time | CO₂/CH₄ closed-chamber slopes | Mole-fraction rate of change; not a flux until chamber volume and area are applied. |
| Mass-normalized rates (`NanoGM-PER-GM-HR`, `MicroMOL-PER-HR-MilliGM`) | Denitrification potential, enzyme activity, respiration per g dry weight | Specific rates. The element basis (as N, C, O₂) and dry-mass basis belong in context, not in the unit. |
| `MilliMOL-PER-MOL-SEC` | Photosynthetic N/P use efficiency | Molar-normalized rate with distinct numerator and denominator substances. |

Candidates with no corpus usage may come from sources outside this snapshot
or from pseudo-unit tables. They need separate follow-up.
